name: Canva Whiteboards
description: Canva Whiteboards is Canva's infinite-space collaborative design type for brainstorming, mapping ideas, workshops, planning, diagrams, and visual teamwork inside the same Canva content library and editor.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Canva Whiteboards connection or install. Connect the canonical Canva provider once, then use its bounded design metadata tools and reviewed blank-design workflow with the stable whiteboard preset. Relay does not expose whiteboard elements, spatial content, comments, collaboration, or arbitrary editing through the current bounded Canva surface.

blocked.label: Create a separate Canva Whiteboards connection
blocked.description: Canva Whiteboards uses the same Canva user, team, OAuth grant, design library, and API as the canonical Canva provider; a second connection would duplicate identity and authority.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Canva Whiteboards tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported design metadata and blank-design actions once through the canonical Canva provider rather than publishing parallel Whiteboards tools and policies.

blocked.label: Read or edit Canva Whiteboards content
blocked.description: The stable bounded Relay Canva surface does not expose whiteboard elements, spatial positions, connectors, notes, drawings, comments, collaboration, arbitrary editing, export, or raw API access.

blocked.label: Run separate Canva Whiteboards actions
blocked.description: Supported whiteboard discovery and blank creation belong to the selected canonical Canva connection and its existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions profile.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Canva
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Canva Whiteboards actions are enabled because Whiteboards is a Canva design type already governed by Relay's canonical Canva provider.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate Canva Whiteboards tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Canva provider with the whiteboard preset for supported workflows.
No duplicate Canva Whiteboards tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Canva provider with the whiteboard preset for supported workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: Canva Whiteboards is a Canva design type, not a separate provider identity or authorization surface. A second provider card, OAuth grant, credential record, installation, policy, or runtime adapter would duplicate the existing Canva connection. Stable Connect APIs expose whiteboard design metadata and blank whiteboard creation but Relay's bounded surface does not expose element-level or spatial editing semantics.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-mode slug non-installable and direct discovery, setup, connection, installation, and execution to the canonical Canva provider. Use canva_design_prepare and approval-gated canva_design_create with designType preset and presetName whiteboard for a reviewed blank Canva Whiteboard; use canva_design_list or canva_design_get for bounded metadata. Revisit element reads, spatial edits, comments, or collaboration only if Canva publishes stable, review-eligible typed APIs and Relay approves their exact scope and data contract.

evidence.supports: Canva defines Whiteboards as designs stored with other designs in the same user Projects and notes that Whiteboards have unlimited width and height.
Canva's stable Create design endpoint accepts whiteboard as a preset within the general designs API under design:content:write and describes it as infinite collaboration space.
Canva made design type metadata stable in July 2026, documents whiteboard on shared Design responses, and classifies whiteboards as unbounded designs.
Canva publishes one Connect API integration model for designs and related content, with public integrations subject to Canva review and preview APIs excluded from public review.
